# System Prompts Leaks
Leaked system prompts of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more. The hidden system prompt of every popular
chatbot, in full, every version since May 2025. Also Anthropic Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google An
tigravity, xAI Grok, Meta Muse, Moonshot Kimi, Alibaba Qwen, Z.ai GLM ZCode, MiniMax, Cursor, Perple
xity, DeepSeek and 30+ others. Updated daily.
Feel free to open up a PR or get in contact if you got a different result.
